title: Filter the source record before FindFirst in Prices Overview caption
summary: The Prices Overview page now correctly displays captions by filtering records before lookup instead of performing an unfiltered search that returned unrelated first records.
key_points: Fixed caption generation in GetFilterDescription() to use SetFilter instead of unfiltered FindFirst()
Applied fix to Customer, Customer Price Group, and Campaign branches
Updated both W1 and APAC layer copies consistently
Added three regression tests covering each branch to verify correct record name appears in caption
